# Poffins

The same in both versions.

## Cooking

You need the **Poffin Case** (from the Pokémon Fan Club in Hearthome City) and a Berry. Cook at the counter in the Poffin House, in Hearthome City. Cooking is solo: the group cooking of the original needs other players.

Choose a Berry from your Bag, then stir with the stylus in the direction of the arrow. Three phases, each up to 20 seconds or 16 turns. Stir too fast and it overflows; too slowly, and it burns (the game warns you). Keep your stylus near the pot's wall. Each burn or overflow takes a point from the Poffin's flavors, and being quicker makes it stronger. The Case holds 100 Poffins.

## What you get

For one Berry: each of the five flavors is that flavor of the Berry minus the next one's (Spicy minus Dry, Dry minus Sweet, Sweet minus Bitter, Bitter minus Sour, Sour minus Spicy), minus one for each flavor that came out below zero, scaled by your cooking speed, less your mistakes. Too many below zero (four or more) makes a Foul Poffin. Smoothness is the Berry's, less one, at least 15.

| Result | When |
|---|---|
| Foul Poffin | no flavor left, or as above: it has three weak random flavors |
| Spicy, Dry, Sweet, Bitter or Sour Poffin | one flavor |
| Two names, such as Spicy-Dry Poffin | two flavors, the stronger first |
| Rich Poffin | three flavors |
| Overripe Poffin | four or more |
| Mild Poffin | any flavor of 50 or more (overrides the others) |

Its level is its main flavor, up to 99. Someone in the Contest Hall lobby also gives you one with Spicy 60, the rest 30, smoothness 40.

## Feeding

Open the Poffin Case from the Bag, choose a Poffin, then a Pokémon. Each flavor adds to its stat, and smoothness adds to Sheen, up to 255 each:

Spicy: Coolness, Dry: Beauty, Sweet: Cuteness, Bitter: Smartness, Sour: Toughness.

**Sheen's limit:** a Pokémon with 255 Sheen eats no more Poffins. So low smoothness is better: more Poffins fit. Feeding raises its friendship by 1 too.

A flavor its nature likes adds 10% more, one it dislikes 10% less. A Pokémon enjoys a Poffin with more of the flavor it likes than of the one it dislikes.
